record.title: Vicovu de Sus–Krasnoilsk truck blockade, January 2024
record.scope: Vicovu de Sus–Krasnoilsk international road crossing
record.direction: Initial notice specifically trucks into Ukraine; later Ukrainian-exit queues also documented, without uniform two-way denial inference.
record.movement: Freight trucks; operating post capacity not generalized to all heavy goods categories
record.exceptions: Other vehicles and pedestrians processed both ways in initial notice; cars continued in January 17 notice.

record.relationship: R15-EU-L005 distinct crossing; linked campaign R16-EU-JAN2024.
record.status_observation: Historical scoped episode; no inference about current frontier policy.
record.official_rationale: Broader protesters sought separate non-EU truck lanes and economic relief; trade code qualified to movement-level demands.
record.uncertainty: No minute-level continuity established; source family mainly Ukrainian border/customs announcements. Do not turn queues into proof every truck was refused.
